title: chirocalyx velutinus
intro: Chirocalyx velutinus, commonly known as Velvet-leaved chirocalyx, is a plant species that belongs to the family Rutaceae. It is traditionally used for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of C. velutinus include soothing skin irritations, reducing fever, and providing relief from respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
